rife_manifest.adaptation: Replace comfy.ops.disable_weight_init with torch.nn; all network math unchanged

decisions: Keep original two-step 512px model and original VAE; full-frame compile was not faster than cached eager
Cache only deterministic static reference VAE argmax latent and invalidate it on every session change
Protocol 2 overlaps capture/upload/generation/download, one unacknowledged upload and one replaceable server mailbox
Smooth mode interpolates whole generated frames, caps playback span at 240ms and clears unfinished playback on stop/change/disconnect
WebP90 method0 replaces JPEG90 for smooth batches; low-latency mode retains JPEG90
limits: 24 original outputs per garment/mode, two garments; sampled image positions differ with processing cadence
Fixed-image source cannot validate human articulation or occlusion; user approved original clothing quality before this optimization
Display FPS includes synthetic intermediate images; native generation remains roughly 3-4 FPS
Smooth display adds about 200ms of browser buffering plus interpolation/transport overhead; it does not lower model or camera latency
Sample-to-draw excludes physical camera exposure and monitor scanout; network and GPU workload can change
First JPEG smoothing trial overlapped browser regressions; final low/smooth trials ran after regressions completed
